why: प्रविद्वान् 'well-knowing' is a regular compound of प्र+विद्वान्; sense and metre fit.
सद्यो जातस्य 'of the just-born one' is required by the sense; ऋतस्य would not fit.
श्रुतस्य 'of the famed one' is a correct genitive and fits the sense of the line.
वृषाव चक्रदत् is the sandhi of वृषा अव चक्रदत्; the 2x form is a sandhi variant, not a typo.
नरो is a mid-pada vocative (unaccented) between other vocatives; the marks are internally consistent with महो udatta.

suggest: अहे॑ळता॒ मन॑सा यातम॒र्वाग॒श्नन्ता॑ ह॒व्यं मानु॑षीषु वि॒क्षु ॥
why: मनस् always carries udatta on the first syllable, so मन॒सा (udatta on सा) with svarita on या॑ looks like a shifted accent, but two marks would have to change.
मरुत्वाँ अवधीः is the regular sandhi of मरुत्वान् before a vowel; 'accompanied by the Maruts' fits.
वर्तयः (injunctive of वर्तय-) 'you rolled' is the required verb; वयः would make no sense.
वरुणा is the dual vocative paired with इन्द्रा; the hymn addresses Indra-Varuna.
कवयः 'O sages' is a regular plural vocative; sense and metre are fine.
At pada start all syllables before the first udatta are marked anudatta, so पृ॒थि॒वी is the correct line-initial form.
वयोधः 'O giver of vigour' is a regular vocative addressed to Soma.
चारुणः is the genitive of चारु agreeing with अमृतस्य; correct.
अश्नाति 'eats' is the verb needed (cf. अश्नाति in the preceding verse).
मघवाँ ऋजीषी is the regular sandhi of मघवान् before a vowel.
मदानां genitive plural with मंहिष्ठः 'most bountiful of exhilarations' is correct.
अज्मस्य 'of the course' is a real word and fits महो ... राजति.
अन्वस्य = अनु अस्य; regular sandhi, sense fine.
मर्ताय 'for the mortal' is correct and contrasts with देवेषु.
द्विमाता 'having two mothers' is a known epithet of Agni; correct.
स्तवान् 'being praised' is a correct participle; देवान् would not fit the syntax.
सुगोपा 'good protectors' (dual) fits ता नो वसू ... स्यातम्.
वार्यस्य 'of the desirable (wealth)' with पूर्धि is correct; सूर्यस्य would not fit.
कृणुतं is the dual imperative matching धत्तं in the same line.
यदिन्द्रः = यत् इन्द्रः; regular sandhi, Indra is the subject of व्याश.
ताम् agrees with इषम् and द्युमतीम्; the accusative is required.
हेतारं 'the shooter/impeller' pairs with प्रहेतारम् earlier in the verse; correct.
नोऽग्ने = नः अग्ने with regular avagraha; correct.
सोमस्त्वा राजा 'King Soma ... you' is the correct nominative plus enclitic.
त्वाऽग्ने marks the elision of अ after आ, a convention this edition also uses in ऽऽहोता॑रं.
समस्य = सम् अस्य 'together ... his'; regular sandhi.
सोमश्च 'and Soma' is correct with यः ... आविवेश.
यमस्य = यम् अस्य, the relative object of वहतः; correct.
वार्येण 'with desirable (wealth)' is correct; सूर्येण would not fit.
रजसा 'through the region' is correct here; वी॑न्द्र is the independent svarita of वि + unaccented vocative इन्द्र.
भ्राजसा 'with brilliance' is a real word fitting अग्निर्न.
न्वोजसा = नु ओजसा; regular sandhi.
विवृश्चन् त्सोमस्य shows the Vedic sandhi n + s with inserted t; the edition's style.
जातस्य च जायमानस्य च 'of born and being born' is clearly the intended pair.
नानाम is the perfect of नम् 'has bowed'; correct.
स्ववसा 'with your own help' is a correct instrumental; fits the dual address.
प्रेन्द्राग्नी = प्र इन्द्राग्नी; regular sandhi, sense fine.
शवसः is the genitive agreeing with स्थिरस्य; correct.
उषसो is a mid-pada vocative (unaccented), hence no udatta marking; accents consistent.
अवन्तु 'let (the songs) favour' is the required plural imperative.
उषसं is the accusative in the list उषसं सूर्यं गाम्; correct.
उग्रासो 'mighty' nominative plural is correct, echoed by उग्रबाहवो.
पुरूरु 'very widely' is a real adverb and fits the metre.
ह्यवसा = हि अवसा; regular sandhi; स्व१र्ण is svara notation.
पीवसा 'with fat' pairs with मेदसा; correct.
नरः is a vocative with अभूतन (2nd pl.), so it is unaccented; marks are consistent.
अवतु 'let him help' is the required singular imperative.
अवता 'help (us)' is a correct plural imperative with देवा.
इन्द्राग्नी is a mid-sentence vocative and so unaccented; the 24x accented form is pada-initial.
सुवितस्य 'of welfare' with विद्वान् is correct.

suggest: अ॒पादे॑ति प्रथ॒मा प॒द्वती॑नां॒ कस्तद् वां॑ मित्रावरुणा चिकेत ।
why: A mid-pada vocative मित्रावरुणा should be unaccented, but the typed marks put an udatta on its final syllable; may be a shifted accent or the edition's reading.
इदस्य = इत् अस्य; regular sandhi, sense fine.
इन्न्वस्य = इत् नु अस्य; regular sandhi.
पत्यमान 'ruling' is correct with इन्द्रो; the ३ after वीर्यै is svara notation.
यतीषु 'among those moving' fits तुरयन्; correct locative.
